title: AW27 Women's Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: Wide shoulders over narrow lines: broad-shouldered and reversible coats, skirt suits, sculptural pleats, round-cut waists and tapered trousers.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Boland sees the upper body widening (80s shoulders, broad chests) over narrower trousers or skirts; key items include the skirt suit, broad-shouldered and reversible double-faced coats, camouflage parka and marl jumper<sup>[1]</sup>
- Cited looks include sculptural pleats, funnel necks, round-cut waists (Jil Sander), padded shoulders (Carven), oversized fur coats (Saint Laurent), teddy-bear coats (Loewe) and all-over lace (Saint Laurent)<sup>[1]</sup>
- Christine Boland's "Individual Familiarity": blazer, skirt, trousers and suit in personal combinations; quiet luxury stays, shown with new linings, piping or colours<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Broad-shoulder coat**, including reversible double-faced.
- **Skirt suit** with a court or pencil skirt.
- **Blazer with padded or rounded shoulder.**
- **Tapered trouser.**
- **Funnel-neck jacket.**

sections.heading: Shapes to watch
sections.body: Teddy and oversized faux-fur coats; camouflage parkas.

design_implications: - Rework shoulder blocks; keep sleeves narrow.
commercial_implications: - Coats and blazers lead the woven buy.

sources.title: Fall/Winter 2027/28 trend report: controlled audacity in an age of agency
